'''Mataou''' was a [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to the [[Ro hypa/Legends|ro hypa]], a [[Snake/Legends|snake]]-like creature whose [[Poison/Legends|venom]] was collected by a [[Colonist/Legends|colony]] of [[Human/Legends|Human]] snake handlers for its medicinal properties. Mataou was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by a [[Drydock/Legends|drydock]] and a [[Mataou fuel station|fuel station]].

==Description==
Mataou was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="GG" /> located in the [[Mataou system/Legends|Mataou system]], a part of the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]]. It was situated in the [[Greater Javin/Legends|Greater Javin]] region within the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The world lay on the [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]] known as the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]], which connected it to the [[Ione system/Legends|Ione system]] as well as the [[Anantapar system/Legends|Anantapar system]] of the neighboring [[Yarith sector/Legends|Yarith sector]]. It was also linked to the [[Ison system/Legends|Ison system]] by the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Ison Trade Corridor/Legends|Ison Corridor]]. Mataou was located inside the [[Ivax Nebula/Legends|Ivax Nebula]].<ref name="TEA" />

Mataou's [[Local year|year]] lasted 440 [[Local day/Legends|local days]], each of which was twenty [[Standard hour/Legends|standard hours]] long. The world's [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] was 110% of standard, and it had a breathable Type I [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]]. A [[Temperature/Legends|hot]] world of ferocious [[Desert/Legends|deserts]], Mataou was [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to the [[Ro hypa/Legends|ro hypa]], a highly [[Poison/Legends|venomous]], [[Snake/Legends|snake]]-like creature. The ro hypa eventually spread throughout the Greater Javin.<ref name="GG" />

==History==
After the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] victory in a [[Galactic Republic–Mugaari war|war]] against the nearby civilization of the [[Mugaari]] [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="GG" /> at some point between approximately [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]] and [[600 BBY/Legends|600 BBY]],<ref name="MugaariDate">{{RepublicMugaariWarDate}}</ref> the former established the [[Javin sector/Legends|Javin sector]] in the former [[Mugaari Space/Legends|Mugaari Space]].<ref name="GG" /> Around [[400 BBY/Legends|400 BBY]],<ref name="SectorDates" /> the portion of the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] containing Mataou was re-designated as the Anoat sector.<ref name="GG" />

==Inhabitants==
Mataou was home to a desert [[Colonist/Legends|colony]] of snake handlers, numbering five thousand [[Human/Legends|Humans]], which collected ro hypa venom for its medicinal properties, exporting it offworld and importing [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuffs]]. The colony had no overarching government and had access to [[Realspace/Legends|space]]-[[Technology level|level]] technology.<ref name="GG" /> Mataou's snake handlers had a legendary reputation,<ref name="TEA" /> and they boasted of being the toughest people in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="GG" />

==Locations==
Mataou featured a [[Standard Class starport]]. The world was used as a [[Fuel/Legends|refueling]] point by [[Starship/Legends|starships]] traveling along the Ison Corridor, and to that end, a [[Mataou fuel station|fuel station]] and a [[Drydock/Legends|drydock]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the world safely above its dangerous surface.<ref name="GG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mataou was introduced in [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' supplement "[[Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin]]," which was published on [[Wizards.com]] on [[March 25]], [[2004]].<ref name="GG" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the world in grid square K-18.<ref name="TEA" />
